subject: Intro demo → Technical scoping workshop - scheduling and options
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@brightpathai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPathAI EngOps <engops@brightpathai.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo: Redwood Inference + BrightPathAI

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the quick connect on the website form. We’re interested in a short intro to Redwood Inference focused on latency characteristics and private deployment options for our on-prem inference instances. At a high level we want to understand:
- typical p95 latency at 2k token contexts
- quantization and memory footprint tradeoffs
- security: VPC/private control plane options and KMS integration

Are you available next week for a 45–60 minute intro? Our exec lead (Sam Park) prefers afternoons PT; other stakeholders (infra + security) will join.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee\Director, AI Infrastructure
BrightPathAI

[attachment: none]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@brightpathai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference + BrightPathAI

Jordan —

Great to meet — happy to run an intro. Given the topics you listed, would you be open to a slightly longer session so we can include a quick Q&A with an engineer (90 minutes)? That will let us show a short demo, surface latency numbers, and leave time for architecture questions.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2027-10-12, 1:00–2:30 PM
- Thu 2027-10-14, 10:00–11:30 AM

If you’d rather do a deeper scoping workshop (hands-on POC planning / access to infra engineers), we can switch formats — Laura (solutions) and Monica (engineering ops) are looped to coordinate. I attached a one-page outline for a short workshop.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra\Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-workshop-outline.md]

From: Jordan Lee <jordan@brightpathai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPathAI EngOps <engops@brightpathai.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference + BrightPathAI

Rishi —

Thanks — after talking to Sam and EngOps, they want to convert the intro into a half-day technical scoping workshop so we can get to mutual action items and alignment on a POC. Our constraints: Sam will be traveling Oct 18–19 (onsite customer meeting), so Oct 15 looks tight. Best windows for our team are Oct 15 (afternoon) or Oct 22 (full/half day). If needed, we can do split sessions across two mornings.

High-level asks for the workshop:
- short performance demo + p95 numbers for 2k/4k contexts
- model variant and quantization recommendations for our workload
- network/security requirements for private deployment (KMS, audit logs)
- mutual action plan with owner/timeline to kick off a POC

Attached: draft agenda (PDF). Can you confirm which of the two dates works for Redwood and whether you can bring an infra engineer?

Regards,
Jordan

[attachment: BP_AI_draft_agenda.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@brightpathai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference + BrightPathAI

Jordan —

Totally reasonable to move to a half-day scoping workshop. We can run either Oct 15 (afternoon) or Oct 22 — provisioning note: our senior infra lead is scheduling travel the week of Oct 18–24, so I need to confirm exact availability.

Option A — single half-day workshop (preferred):
- Fri 2027-10-22, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM PT (agenda aligned to your PDF)
- attendees from Redwood: me (solutions), Monica (infra ops), + one senior infra engineer (TBD)

Option B — split into two focused sessions:
- Thu 2027-10-14, 10:00–12:00 PT (performance + demo + immediate Q&A)
- Tue 2027-10-19, 10:00–12:00 PT (security & deployment planning + MAP)

I’ve attached a mutual action plan template — if you can confirm owners for the rows, we’ll lock the rest on our side. Which option do you prefer? If Oct 22 is the best on your side, I’ll check internal travel windows and get back within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Rishi
[attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx]

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference + BrightPathAI

Rishi / Laura —

Heads up: I’ll be traveling Oct 20–24 for an on-prem install and can't staff a live half-day on Oct 22. Our senior infra lead (Diego) also has a travel window overlapping Oct 18–23 for a different customer, so Oct 22 looks risky for the usual team.

A couple of options we should offer to BrightPathAI:
1) Move the workshop to Fri Oct 29 — everyone will be back and we can do the full half-day with the full infra crew.
2) Run two shorter moderated sessions on Oct 22 + 23 with one senior engineer joining remotely for the critical segments (performance demo + deployment Q&A).
3) Keep Oct 22 but Rishi or Laura run the session and record the deep infra demo; follow up with a dedicated 60–90m deep-dive when Diego is back.

My preference is option 1 if their schedule allows — fewer moving pieces and better experience. If they need earlier, option 2 is workable.

Monica Patel\Principal Infra Ops, Redwood Inference

Jordan —

A) Move the half-day workshop to Fri, 2027-10-29 (9:00 AM–1:00 PM PT) — full infra presence and we’ll bring Diego for the deep demo.
B) Keep an earlier window and split into two focused remote sessions: Oct 22 (performance demo + Q&A) and Oct 23 (security & deployment planning). We’ll have a senior engineer remote for the critical blocks.

Which works best for your team? If you prefer option A (Oct 29) we’ll send a calendar hold and update the mutual action plan. If you need earlier, we’ll prep split agendas and record any missing infra demo segments.
